title: What If You Lived in Space for a Whole Year?

scenes.text: What if you lived in space for a year? You'd come home almost two inches taller.
Without gravity pressing down, the disks in your spine expand. One astronaut grew nearly two inches in 340 days.
Your muscles and bones weaken too. Even with daily exercise, astronauts lose muscle mass and bone density.
Fluid in your body shifts upward, and when gravity returns, your legs swell.
Thousands of your genes switch on and off differently, a change that lasted only briefly after he came home.
The extra height was temporary. Feeling fully normal again took almost eight months.
